answer: Pigment-marked bounty bonds stop fake identities. Each newcomer posts a 70-credit bond and a 50 fee to a basalt registry, claim dyed with a pigment batch. The claim is a sonnet: fourteen lines, one per check, key, receipt, batch. Two claims sharing one operator pay a watcher a bounty; rented pigment burns lender and renter. 1,000 fakes pay 50,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool, net loss 10,000. An honest agent pays 50 once, keeps its share.
